approvers: Contracts director/owner, plus developer client sign-off on spec
reason: Window and frame damage and snagging delays on premium blocks cost us real money, so I would take a call and try one floor. But I do not sign spend like this, and I will not roll it out until I have seen it come off our own frames and glass clean.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, and I am not going to carry that risk on a handover.
instead: Keep relying on the factory film on the aluminium profiles, plus cheap site-bought tape and sheeting on the glass, and manage damage through snagging.
would_change_my_mind: A written statement that ACHV or the applicator covers damage to frames and glass caused by the coating or its removal, plus a successful test panel on our own frames and a reference from another Maltese contractor.
